card.name: Linking words before study-result terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as a, the, in, or adjusted that come right before a result term like causal link, rate of death, increased, or relative risk. They appear in warning text about antidepressants, anticonvulsants and trials.

modes.label: Article before risk wording
modes.description: The word a or the right after a clause opener, ahead of causal link or rate of death.
modes.example: Although<< a>> causal link between the emergence of such symptoms

modes.label: Preposition or modifier before outcome
modes.description: A short word such as in or adjusted that leads into an outcome or risk figure.
modes.example: had approximately twice the risk (<<adjusted>> Relative Risk 1.8,
